subject: MAP draft: Integration milestone owners (SDK / streaming / tool-calls)
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Peters <sam.peters@ellipsishealth.com>, Ravi Menon <ravi.m@ellipsishealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 02 May 2026 22:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft: Integration milestone owners (SDK / streaming / tool-calls)

Hi Sam / Ravi — thanks again for the call today. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan focused on the integration milestones we discussed (SDK integration, streaming/tool-calls, and structured-output spec). Quick recap and asks below: 

Summary milestones (proposed):
- M1: Kickoff & environment access (Ellipsis provides test account + network details) — target: 2026-05-10
- M2: SDK integration (build + sample app) — owner: Ellipsis devs / Redwood SDK support — target: 2026-05-24
- M3: Streaming + tool-calls wiring (webhook/tool adapter + retries) — owner: Redwood eng (Ben) + Ellipsis infra — target: 2026-06-04
- M4: Structured outputs / schema validation (JSON schema + example prompts) — owner: Marissa / Product — target: 2026-06-08
- M5: E2E validation & perf smoke tests (latency & cost baseline) — owner: Ben / Ellipsis SRE — target: 2026-06-15

Dependencies we flagged on the call:
- Security questionnaire completion (SOC2 evidence) — blocks M2 sign-off
- Network/IP allowlist + service account creds from you for streaming endpoints
- PRD for structured outputs (sample payloads) from product team

Asks / next steps: 
1) Please confirm owners on your side for M1–M3 and whether the proposed targets are achievable.
2) Can we get a copy of the security questionnaire answers by 2026-05-07?
3) I'll schedule a 60-minute technical deep-dive next week (SDK + streaming) — proposed times in a follow-up.

Attachments: redwood_map_v1.pdf (MAP draft)

Thanks — will iterate once you send feedback.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198
From: Sam Peters <sam.peters@ellipsishealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ravi Menon <ravi.m@ellipsishealth.com>
Date: Sun, 03 May 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft: Integration milestone owners (SDK / streaming / tool-calls)

Thanks Aditya — appreciate the clear breakdown. A few notes from our side: 
- Overall timeline looks reasonable but we should shift M2 out one week (SDK integration to 2026-06-01) because our backend team is tied up with a release next week.
- Security questionnaire: we can return answers by 2026-05-08 (one day later than your ask). We also need Redwood to confirm data retention defaults and whether KV cache is persisted across pods (Ravi to follow up).
- For streaming: we prefer using our webhook adapter behind API Gateway; we will share ingress IP ranges once the app team spins up the staging stack.

Action from Ellipsis: Ravi will own M1/M2 coordination on our side. I (Sam) will own the product/validation for structured outputs.

Can we get the technical deep-dive scheduled for Wed 2026-05-06 between 9–11am PT?

Sam
Sam Peters
Director of Product, Ellipsis Health
sam.peters@ellipsishealth.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Peters <sam.peters@ellipsishealth.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 04 May 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft: Integration milestone owners (SDK / streaming / tool-calls)

On Sun, May 3, 2026 at 9:04 AM Sam Peters <sam.peters@ellipsishealth.com> wrote:
> Thanks Aditya — appreciate the clear breakdown. A few notes from our side: 
> - Overall timeline looks reasonable but we should shift M2 out one week (SDK integration to 2026-06-01) because our backend team is tied up with a release next week.

Thanks Sam — noted. I pulled together a short technical deep-dive agenda and a lightweight SDK checklist (attached) so the teams have clear owners and deliverables. Highlights below: 

Technical deep-dive agenda (60m):
- 0–10m: Introductions + environment access checklist (Ravi)
- 10–30m: SDK integration walkthrough (sample app, auth, error handling) — owner: Marissa/SDK team
- 30–45m: Streaming & tool-calls plumbing (webhook patterns, adapters, retries, idempotency) — owner: Ben/Platform
- 45–55m: Structured outputs & schema validation (example prompts, failure modes) — owner: Sam + Marissa
- 55–60m: Next steps & action items (assign owners in MAP)

Proposed owners (internal):
- SDK enablement / docs: Marissa Cole
- Runtime & streaming infra: Ben Carter
- Account coordination & MSPs: Aditya Rao

I attached sdk_integration_checklist.xlsx with things we'll demo and test during the POC — auth flows, sample code, common error cases, and basic perf checks. Please confirm Wed 2026-05-06 09:30am PT for the deep-dive; if that works I'll send a calendar invite + Zoom link and a short read-ahead.

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachment: sdk_integration_checklist.xlsx (checklist, sample commands)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sam Peters <sam.peters@ellipsishealth.com>
Date: Tue, 05 May 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft: Integration milestone owners (SDK / streaming / tool-calls)

Quick confirmations from platform side:
- Ben (Platform) will own streaming plumbing and the perf smoke tests. I'll add long-haul perf to the checklist (30m sustained at target QPS).
- We should create an Ops Slack channel (redwood-ellipsis-deploy) so on-call can triage early issues during the POC. Can Aditya create that and invite Ben + Ravi?
- LGTM on the attached MAP draft pending the revised M2 date to 2026-06-01.

I'll post a brief runbook after the deep-dive with endpoints, retry semantics, and observability keys.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Principal Platform Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
